english_meaning: Something bought for less than its usual price; also to negotiate a lower price.
gujarati_meaning: ઓછી કિંમતે ખરીદાયેલ ચીજ, અથવા ભાવ ઘટાડવા માટે વાટાઘાટ કરવી.
usage_note: As a verb: 'to bargain' = to negotiate price. As a noun: 'a bargain' = a great deal.
memory_tip: 'bar' = ઘટાડ + 'gain' = ફાયદો → bargain = સસ્તો ફાયદો.
examples: This jacket was a real bargain at half price.
She loves bargain hunting at flea markets.
They bargained for a lower price.
It's a bargain you can't refuse.

english_meaning: To buy something; or the act of buying something.
gujarati_meaning: કંઈ ખરીદવું; અથવા ખરીદીની ક્રિયા.
usage_note: 'Purchase' is more formal than 'buy'. Used in official receipts and documents.
memory_tip: 'pur' = સારી રીતે + 'chase' = પીછો → purchase = ચીજ પાછળ ધ્યાન આપી ખરીદવી.
examples: She made a purchase at the online store.
Please keep your purchase receipt.
The purchase was completed within minutes.
He purchased a new laptop yesterday.

english_meaning: A person or company that sells goods or services.
gujarati_meaning: એક વ્યક્તિ અથવા કંપની જે ચીજો અથવા સેવાઓ વેચે છે.
usage_note: Street vendors sell goods outdoors; online vendors sell through websites.
memory_tip: 'Vend' = વેચવું (Latin) → vendor = વેચનાર.
examples: The street vendor sells fresh fruit every morning.
We chose a reliable vendor for office supplies.
The food vendor set up a stall near the park.
Online vendors offer competitive prices.

english_meaning: A written or printed document confirming payment for goods or services.
gujarati_meaning: ખરીદી માટે ચૂકવણીની પુષ્ટિ આપતો લખિત અથવા છાપેલ કાગળ.
usage_note: Always keep your receipt in case you need to return or exchange an item.
memory_tip: 'Receive' = મળ્યું → receipt = મળ્યાની ચિઠ્ઠી.
examples: Can I have a receipt for this purchase?
Keep the receipt if you want to return it.
The receipt shows the date and price.
She lost her receipt and couldn't get a refund.

english_meaning: Money returned to a customer when they return a product or cancel a service.
gujarati_meaning: ગ્રાહક ચીજ પરત કરે અથવા સેવા રદ કરે ત્યારે પાછા અપાતા પૈસા.
usage_note: You may need the original receipt to claim a refund.
memory_tip: 'Re' = પાછું + 'fund' = પૈસા → refund = પૈસા પાછા.
examples: I asked for a refund because the item was defective.
The store gave me a full refund.
The refund was credited to my account.
Their refund policy allows 30 days.

english_meaning: To give one thing and receive another in return; to swap a product for a different one.
gujarati_meaning: એક ચીજ આપીને બીજી લેવી; ખરીદેલ ઉત્પાદ બદલાવવું.
usage_note: In shopping: exchange means replacing a product with a different size/colour.
memory_tip: 'Ex' = બહાર + 'change' = બદલ → exchange = બહાર-અંદર બદલવું.
examples: Can I exchange this shirt for a larger size?
The shop allows exchange within 7 days.
They exchanged gifts on Christmas.
The exchange rate affects international shopping.

english_meaning: The selling of goods in large quantities at lower prices, typically to retailers.
gujarati_meaning: ઓછા ભાવે મોટા જથ્થામાં ચીજો વેચવી, ખાસ કરીને દુકાનદારોને.
usage_note: Wholesale requires buying large quantities; not typically available to individual consumers.
memory_tip: 'Whole' = આખો → wholesale = આખો/ઘણો સામાન સસ્તામાં.
examples: She buys fabric wholesale for her boutique.
Wholesale prices are much lower than retail.
He is a wholesale dealer in electronics.
The wholesale market opens at 5 AM.

english_meaning: The sale of goods to individual consumers in small quantities.
gujarati_meaning: વ્યક્તિગત ગ્રાહકોને નાની માત્રામાં ચીજો વેચવી.
usage_note: Retail prices are higher than wholesale because of added costs.
memory_tip: 'Re' + 'tail' = ફરી + છેડો → retail = છેલ્લો ગ્રાહક સુધી વેચાણ.
examples: The retail price of this phone is ₹15,000.
She works in retail management.
The retail sector has grown this year.
Retail stores attract many shoppers on weekends.

english_meaning: To argue or negotiate over the price of something, especially in a market.
gujarati_meaning: ખાસ કરીને બજારમાં ભાવ ઘટાડવા માટે ઝઘડો/વાટાઘાટ કરવી.
usage_note: Haggling is common and expected in street markets and bazaars.
memory_tip: 'Haggle' = ઘા-ઘૂ → ઘા-ઘૂ કરી ભાવ ઘટાડવો — that's haggling!
examples: She haggled the price down by 30%.
Don't be afraid to haggle at the market.
He haggled with the vendor for 10 minutes.
Haggling is a skill that saves money.

english_meaning: An offer of a specific price for something at an auction or in a competition.
gujarati_meaning: હરાજી અથવા સ્પર્ધામાં ચોક્કસ ભાવ ઑફર કરવો.
usage_note: In online shopping (e.g., eBay), users bid to win items.
memory_tip: 'Bid' = બોલ → 'bid' = ભાવ બોલવો (in auction).
examples: She placed a bid of ₹5,000 on the antique vase.
The winning bid was much higher than expected.
He bid on several items at the auction.
Online bidding is common on platforms like eBay.

english_meaning: A document sent by a seller to a buyer, listing goods/services and the amount owed.
gujarati_meaning: વેચનાર દ્વારા ખરીદનારને મોકલવામાં આવેલ કાગળ, જેમાં ચીજો અને ચૂકવવાની રકમ હોય.
usage_note: Invoices are used in business transactions; receipts are given at retail stores.
memory_tip: 'In' + 'voice' = અંદર + અવાજ → invoice = ગ્રાહક સુધી પૈસા માટેનો 'અવાજ' (demand).
examples: Please send the invoice by email.
The invoice is due within 30 days.
She received an invoice for the repair service.
The invoice lists all items purchased.

english_meaning: Goods sent to a seller to sell on behalf of the owner, with payment after sale.
gujarati_meaning: માલ માલિક વતી વેચવા માટે વેચનારને મોકલવો, વેચ્યા પછી ચૂકવણી.
usage_note: In consignment selling, the seller only pays the supplier after goods are sold.
memory_tip: 'Con' + 'sign' = સાથે + સહી → consignment = સહી કરી માલ સોંપવો.
examples: She sells clothes on consignment at the boutique.
The consignment arrived yesterday.
He operates a consignment store for used goods.
Payment is made once the consignment is sold.

english_meaning: A reduction in the price of a product, often to clear stock.
gujarati_meaning: ઉત્પાદનની કિંમત ઘટાડવી, ઘણી વખત સ્ટૉક ખાલી કરવા.
usage_note: Opposite of markup; stores markdown prices during clearance sales.
memory_tip: 'Mark' = ભાવ + 'down' = નીચે → markdown = ભાવ નીચો.
examples: The store offered a 40% markdown on winter coats.
Items are marked down after the holiday season.
Look for markdowns to save money.
The markdown brought more customers in.

english_meaning: The amount added to the cost price of goods to cover expenses and profit.
gujarati_meaning: ચીજની કિંમત ઉપર ઉમેરાયેલ રકમ, ખર્ચ અને નફો આવરવા.
usage_note: A 50% markup means a product that costs ₹100 is sold for ₹150.
memory_tip: 'Mark' = ભાવ + 'up' = ઉપર → markup = ભાવ ઉપર.
examples: Luxury brands have a very high markup.
The markup on electronics is usually 20-30%.
She calculated the markup to determine the selling price.
High markups reduce customer loyalty.

english_meaning: An excess of production or stock beyond what is needed.
gujarati_meaning: જરૂર કરતા વધારે ઉત્પાદન અથવા સ્ટૉક.
usage_note: Surplus goods are often sold at reduced prices to clear inventory.
memory_tip: 'Sur' = ઉપર/વધારે (French/Latin) → surplus = વધારાનો.
examples: The store has a surplus of summer clothes.
Surplus food was donated to the charity.
A trade surplus means more exports than imports.
They sold surplus inventory at a discount.

english_meaning: A complete list of goods/products a business has in stock.
gujarati_meaning: એક વ્યવસાયમાં ઉપલબ્ધ ચીજોની સંપૂર્ણ યાદી.
usage_note: Regular inventory checks help businesses avoid stockouts or overstocking.
memory_tip: 'Invent' + 'ory' = ઊભું કરેલ + સ્થળ → inventory = ચીજો ઊભી કરેલ/રાખેલ જગ્યા.
examples: The manager did an inventory check this morning.
They use software for inventory management.
The inventory shows 50 units remaining.
Out-of-stock items need inventory restocking.

english_meaning: To send back a purchased item to the store, usually for a refund or exchange.
gujarati_meaning: ખરીદેલ ચીજ દુકાને પાછી આપવી, ઘણી વખત રિફંડ અથવા બદલી માટે.
usage_note: Most stores have a return window (e.g., 15 or 30 days) with receipt required.
memory_tip: 'Re' = પાછું + 'turn' = ફેરવ → return = ફરી પાછું ફેરવવું.
examples: I need to return these shoes; they don't fit.
The store has a 30-day return policy.
She returned the dress and got a full refund.
Returning items online is easy with prepaid labels.

english_meaning: A label attached to a product showing its price.
gujarati_meaning: ઉત્પાદ ઉપર લગાડેલ ટૅગ જે ભાવ દર્શાવે.
usage_note: Also used figuratively: 'the price tag of success' = the cost of achieving something.
memory_tip: 'Price' = ભાવ + 'tag' = ટૅગ/ચિઠ્ઠી → price tag = ભાવ ચિઠ્ઠી.
examples: Always check the price tag before buying.
She removed the price tag as a gift.
The price tag said ₹2,500.
Some luxury items don't display a price tag.

english_meaning: A reduction in the usual price of something.
gujarati_meaning: ચીજની સામાન્ย કિંમતમાં ઘટાડો.
usage_note: Discounts are given in percentage (10% off) or fixed amount (₹100 off).
memory_tip: 'Dis' = દૂર + 'count' = ગણ → discount = ભાવ ગણ દૂર (ઘટાડ).
examples: The shop offered a 20% discount on all items.
She got a student discount at the museum.
Are there any discounts for bulk buying?
The discount code saved me ₹500.

english_meaning: To discuss something to reach an agreement, especially about a price.
gujarati_meaning: કોઈ વ્યાપારિક સોદો, ખાસ કરીને ભાવ અંગે, સંમતિ મળે ત્યાં સુધી ચર્ચા કરવી.
usage_note: Negotiation is a key business skill; also used in salary discussions.
memory_tip: 'Neg' + 'otiate' = ના + ઓ → negotiation = 'ના' ન પડે ત્યાં સુધી ચર્ચા.
examples: He negotiated the price down by ₹2,000.
She is good at negotiating deals.
They negotiated the terms of the contract.
Negotiate politely for best results.

english_meaning: A voucher that gives the holder a discount or special offer.
gujarati_meaning: એક વાઉચર જે ધારક ને ડિસ્કાઉન્ટ અથવા ખાસ ઑફર આપે.
usage_note: Coupons can be physical (cut from a newspaper) or digital (promo codes online).
memory_tip: 'Coupon' = ફ્રેન્ચ 'couper' (કાપવું) → coupon = ભાવ ઘટાડો ક્યારેક.
examples: Use this coupon to get 15% off.
She collected coupons from magazines.
Enter the coupon code at checkout.
The coupon expires at the end of the month.

english_meaning: A period when a shop sells goods at reduced prices.
gujarati_meaning: એવો સમય જ્યારે દુકાન ઘટાડેલ ભાวે ચીજો વેચે.
usage_note: 'On sale' means reduced price. 'For sale' means available to buy.
memory_tip: 'Sale' = વેચાણ → સસ્તામાં ઘણો 'sale' (વેચાણ) — great deals!
examples: The shop has a big sale every January.
These shoes are on sale for half price.
She waited for the sale to buy the coat.
Flash sales last only a few hours.

english_meaning: Priced too high; costing more than the item is worth.
gujarati_meaning: ભાવ ઘણો વધારે, ચીજ જેટલી કિંમત છે તેના કરતા ઘણી મોંઘી.
usage_note: Used when the buyer feels they are not getting value for money.
memory_tip: 'Over' = વધારે + 'priced' = ભાવ → overpriced = ભાવ ઘણો વધારે.
examples: This coffee is so overpriced for what you get.
Tourists often pay overpriced rates.
The hotel was luxurious but overpriced.
I refused to buy the overpriced souvenir.

english_meaning: Reasonably priced; not too expensive to buy.
gujarati_meaning: વ્યાજબી ભાવ; ખૂબ મોંઘી ન હોય.
usage_note: 'Afford' = to have enough money. 'Affordable' = priced within reach.
memory_tip: 'Afford' = ભોગવી શકવું → affordable = ભોગવી શકાય એ ભાવ.
examples: This restaurant offers affordable meals.
We found an affordable apartment near the city.
The brand is known for affordable fashion.
Are there any more affordable options?

english_meaning: A stated price for a product or service before purchase; to state such a price.
gujarati_meaning: ખરીદી પહેલા ઉત્પાદ/સેવા માટે જણાવેલ ભાવ; ભાว જણાવવો.
usage_note: 'Quote' and 'quotation' are interchangeable for prices.
memory_tip: 'Quote' = 'quotation' = ભાવ-ચિઠ્ઠી → quote = ભાવ જણાવ.
examples: Can you give me a quote for the renovation?
The plumber quoted ₹3,000 for the repair.
She got three quotes before choosing a supplier.
The quote was much higher than expected.

english_meaning: An approximate calculation of cost or value.
gujarati_meaning: ખર્ચ અથવા મૂલ્યની અંદાજિત ગણતરી.
usage_note: Estimates can be rough or detailed; they may change once work begins.
memory_tip: 'Estimate' = 'estimate' (અંગ્રેજી) = અંદાજ → estimate = અંદાજ.
examples: The contractor gave a rough estimate of ₹50,000.
We estimated the total cost at ₹1 lakh.
Please send a written estimate by Friday.
The actual cost was close to the estimate.

english_meaning: Getting good quality or quantity in exchange for the price paid.
gujarati_meaning: ચૂકવેલ ભાવ અનુસાર સારી ગુણવત્તા અથવા માત્રા મળવી.
usage_note: Often used in reviews: 'This product offers excellent value for money.'
memory_tip: 'Value' = મૂલ્ય + 'money' = પૈસા → value for money = પૈસા ઉઠ્ઠાં = worthwhile!
examples: This all-inclusive hotel is great value for money.
The course offered excellent value for money.
Cheap products aren't always value for money.
Consumers look for value for money when shopping.

english_meaning: A sale in which goods are sold cheaply to get rid of old stock.
gujarati_meaning: પૂરાણો સ્ટૉક ઓછા ભાવે ઉડાડી દેવા ગોઠવેલ વેચાણ.
usage_note: Clearance items often cannot be returned or exchanged.
memory_tip: 'Clear' = સાફ → clearance = સ્ટૉક સાફ (ઉડાડ) → clearance sale.
examples: I bought a coat in the clearance sale.
The clearance rack has 70% off items.
They held a clearance sale to make room for new stock.
Check clearance sections for the best deals.

english_meaning: The act of arguing or negotiating about the price of something.
gujarati_meaning: ભાવ ઘટાડવા માટે ઝઘડો/ચર્ચા કરવાની ક્રિયા.
usage_note: In many cultures, haggling is expected and seen as part of the shopping experience.
memory_tip: 'Haggle' = ઘા-ઘૂ → haggling = ઘા-ઘૂ કરી ભાવ ઘટાડ.
examples: Haggling is common in Turkish bazaars.
She improved her haggling skills on a trip to Morocco.
He is not comfortable with haggling.
A bit of haggling can save you a lot.

english_meaning: A set price that cannot be negotiated or changed.
gujarati_meaning: એક નક્કી ભાવ જે વાટાઘાટ અથવા બદલી ન શકાય.
usage_note: Supermarkets and malls typically have fixed prices; bazaars and markets often don't.
memory_tip: 'Fixed' = નક્કી + 'price' = ભાવ → fixed price = નક્કી ભાવ.
examples: The restaurant offers a fixed price lunch menu.
Their policy is fixed price — no negotiations.
Fixed price contracts help avoid disputes.
Unlike markets, malls have fixed prices.

english_meaning: A general increase in prices and fall in the purchasing value of money.
gujarati_meaning: ભાવ સ્તરમાં સામાન્ય વૃદ્ધિ અને પૈસાની ખરીદ-શક્તિ ઘટવી.
usage_note: Central banks raise interest rates to control inflation.
memory_tip: 'Inflate' = ફૂલવું → inflation = ભાવ ફૂલ્યા/ચઢ્યા.
examples: High inflation has made groceries expensive.
The inflation rate is 6% this year.
Inflation affects the purchasing power of citizens.
Governments try to keep inflation under control.

english_meaning: The most favorable price a buyer is willing to pay or a seller is willing to accept.
gujarati_meaning: ખરીદનાર ભરવા માટે અથવા વેચનાર સ્વીકારવા તૈયાર હોય તે સૌથી સારો ભાવ.
usage_note: Often abbreviated as 'OBO' (or best offer) in classified ads.
memory_tip: 'Best' = સૌથી સારો + 'offer' = ઑફર → best offer = સૌથી સારો/સસ્તો ભાવ.
examples: The listing says ₹10,000 or best offer.
She made her best offer, and they accepted.
What's your best offer for this car?
Best offers are often welcomed in second-hand markets.

english_meaning: When a store agrees to sell a product at the same price as a competitor.
gujarati_meaning: જ્યારે દુકાન સ્પર્ધક જેટલા ભાવે ઉત્પાદ વેચવા સહમત થાય.
usage_note: Many large retailers offer price-match guarantees to attract customers.
memory_tip: 'Price' = ભાવ + 'match' = સ્પર્ધક = price match = ભાવ મળ.
examples: The store will price match any competitor's offer.
She got a price match and saved ₹800.
Ask about price match guarantees before buying.
Their price match policy applies to online stores too.

english_meaning: The original listed price of a product before any discounts.
gujarati_meaning: ડિસ્કાઉન્ટ પહેલા ઉત્પાદ ઉપર લિસ્ટ કરેલ મૂળ ભાવ.
usage_note: The sticker price on a car is usually negotiable at dealerships.
memory_tip: 'Sticker' = ચોંટેલ ટૅગ + 'price' = ભાવ → sticker price = ટૅગ ઉપર ભાવ.
examples: The sticker price of the car was ₹8 lakh.
We negotiated below the sticker price.
Sticker prices are often higher than what you pay.
Never pay the sticker price without negotiating.
